name: charges weighted costs and does not charge denied requests
input: one key with an over-budget request between two accepted requests
test:
operations = [
    ('allow', 'a', 6, 1),
    ('allow', 'a', 5, 2),
    ('allow', 'a', 4, 3),
]
assert process_operations(10, 5, operations) == [True, False, True]

name: uses calendar boundaries and keeps keys independent
input: requests at a window boundary for two keys
test:
operations = [
    ('allow', 'a', 10, 4),
    ('allow', 'a', 1, 5),
    ('allow', 'b', 10, 5),
    ('allow', 'b', 1, 6),
]
assert process_operations(10, 5, operations) == [True, True, True, False]

name: reset clears the key even inside its current window
input: a reset followed by another full-budget request
test:
operations = [
    ('allow', 'a', 7, 11),
    ('reset', 'a', 12),
    ('allow', 'a', 10, 12),
    ('allow', 'a', 1, 14),
    ('allow', 'a', 10, 15),
]
assert process_operations(10, 5, operations) == [True, 'ok', True, False, True]
